facts.about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration  . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS  .

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 101% of PAT

business.summary: Persistent Systems provides software product engineering and digital transformation services. It generates revenue by delivering technology solutions, application development, testing, and maintenance services to clients across various industries, including BFSI, healthcare, and hi-tech sectors.

segments.name: BFSI
segments.note: Segment revenue reached INR 50,932.99 Million in FY 2025-26.

segments.name: Healthcare & Life Sciences
segments.note: Segment revenue reached INR 37,721.65 Million in FY 2025-26.

segments.name: Software, Hi-Tech and Emerging Industries
segments.note: Segment revenue reached INR 58,829.85 Million in FY 2025-26.

guidance.statement: We want to be in the 16 to 17% range, that is our aspiration.
guidance.quote: So, from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration.

guidance.statement: We expect the deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.

guidance.statement: We are confident of maintaining our growth in the existing Persistent part of it.
guidance.quote: we are very confident, first, about maintaining our growth in the existing Persistent part of it

guidance.statement: We believe we can maintain the margins and better them.
guidance.quote: we believe we can maintain the margins and better them.

guidance.statement: The transaction is expected to be Reported EPS accretive in Year 1.
guidance.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses that will be incurred in the first year.

guidance.statement: We are confident of bringing this back to an industry leading growth.
guidance.quote: we are very confident of bringing this back to an industry leading growth.

guidance.statement: We are marching towards the $2 billion run rate by FY27 steadily.
guidance.quote: The $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.

guidance.statement: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
guidance.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.

guidance.statement: We remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027.
guidance.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

guidance.statement: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
guidance.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.

scorecard.promised: Marching towards $2 billion run rate by FY27 steadily.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue reached ₹4,664 cr in Sep 2026, approximately $2.2 billion annualized run-rate.
scorecard.evidence: Sep 2026 revenue of ₹4,664 cr multiplied by four exceeds the $2 billion target at current exchange rates.

scorecard.promised: Aspiration to maintain a range of 16% to 17%.
scorecard.evidence: Margins dropped from 19% in Mar 2026 to 16% in Jun 2026 and 14% in Sep 2026.

scorecard.promised: Expect deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.
scorecard.delivered: Secured 94.04% of share capital as of Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Management reports exceeding the 50% threshold but final closure is slated for late 2026 or early 2027.

scorecard.promised: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
scorecard.delivered: FY26 Net Profit of ₹1,865 cr suggests tax alignment.
scorecard.evidence: Annual net profit grew 33% in FY26, consistent with guided tax ranges and operational growth.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully scaled revenue to meet ambitious $2 billion targets, but aggressive acquisitions and wage hikes have severely compromised margin aspirations.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: AI initiatives and tool-driven pricing would be margin neutral or accretive.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margins have compressed by 500 basis points over the last two quarters.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: The company is maintaining industry-leading growth in its existing business.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth accelerated to 30.2% YoY in Sep 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: India revenue growth was an aberration due to billing classification.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Quarterly revenue growth remained high and steady following the reported aberration.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, reaching 30.2% YoY in the most recent quarter.
Strong cash generation with five-year operating cash flow at 101% of net profit.
Successful $125 million annual large deal win provides long-term revenue visibility.
bear: EBITDA margins have collapsed from 19% to 14% in just six months.
High client concentration with the top 10 customers accounting for 41.6% of revenue.
Significant geographical risk with North America contributing over 81% of total sales.
watch: Final Nagarro deal closure and impact of integration costs on FY27 EPS.

claims.claim: We have secured 94.04% of Nagarro share capital and intend to squeeze out remaining minority shareholders.
claims.quote: We have secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital excluding treasury shares at the expiry of the additional acceptance period, significantly exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 50% + 1 share.

claims.claim: Our Software Reinvention offering helps clients modernize legacy products and deliver AI-native products, creating a significant moat.
claims.quote: Our Software Reinvention offering is designed to help software and technology companies deliver AI native products as well as modernize their legacy products for an AI first world.

claims.claim: EBIT margins declined 130 bps YoY due to annual wage hikes, lower utilization, and higher amortization from large deals.
claims.quote: EBIT margins for Q2 FY27 came in at 15%, 130 basis points declined year-on-year.

claims.claim: This is an expansion play bringing together people, capabilities, and markets that are complementary to us.
claims.quote: This is not a consolidation play. This is an expansion play for us bringing together, as Anand rightly pointed out, people, capabilities, markets which are all complimentary to us

claims.claim: This is a net new deal adding $125 million plus annually for 6.5 years.
claims.quote: this is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

claims.claim: The integration will be a planned execution over time, and we are confident of doing it the right way.
claims.quote: Obviously, it will be a planned execution of integration over a period of time and usually these things have to slow roll. Usually these things will take time to create value but we are very confident of doing it the right way.

claims.claim: We do not expect much seasonality in revenue as AI initiatives become part of services engagements.
claims.quote: So, we do not expect much of a seasonality because of that. It will be basically a part of our scaling up the AI initiative.

claims.claim: Using AI technology should be margin neutral or accretive by enabling more work with fewer people.
claims.quote: And most of these things should be margin neutral or accretive because if we use technology, we should be able to do more work with lesser people and more technology.

claims.claim: The strong growth in India this quarter was an aberration due to billing classification of an IT customer.
claims.quote: The India part is an aberration. The thing that happened there is one of our IT customers in our erstwhile Accelerite business, the renewal happened in rupee (INR) terms through their GCC.

claims.claim: AI platform and tool-driven pricing models contributed to a 150 basis point improvement in EBIT margin this quarter.
claims.quote: Couple of engagements of this nature, which we signed in the last quarter and which are now scaling up, have contributed to an improvement in margin by 150 basis points.

claims.claim: New labor codes caused a one-time 230 basis point EBIT margin headwind; future provisioning will follow these codes.
claims.quote: In addition, there was a one-time impact of 230 basis points on EBIT margin on account of increased provisioning for gratuity and leave encashment in accordance with the New Labour Code.

claims.claim: Growth in intangible assets will slow as tools reach maturity, with revenue generation justifying past capitalization.
claims.quote: I think so it has, they are now at a pretty good amount of maturity level whereby the growth in these intangibles will not be at the same level as what you have seen in the past.

claims.claim: Persistent's hi-tech strategy focuses on core product development and engineering, differentiating it from peers focused on general IT.
claims.quote: We are at the core of the engine. We are in the product development and the related side of it, whether it is doing professional services, customer support, nine yards.

risks.text: Company seeks recovery of INR 21.12 Million in deposits from the IL&FS Group.
North America contributes 81.4% of total revenue, indicating significant geographical concentration risk.
Top 10 customers account for 41.6% of total revenue, representing client concentration.
